info.name: Bootstrap 5, Responsive Breakpoints
info.description: Displays a live, semi-transparent overlay in the bottom-left corner of any webpage showing the current Bootstrap 5 responsive breakpoint and screen orientation. As you resize your browser window, the indicator updates in real time across all six breakpoints — XS (<576px), SM (≥576px), MD (≥768px), LG (≥992px), XL (≥1200px), and XXL (≥1400px) — plus a second line that toggles between Portrait and Landscape. A handy visual aid for frontend developers building or debugging responsive layouts with Bootstrap 5.
